name: PLYTEC
recent: PLYTEC 近期以 RM6.21m 收购 Kuala Langat 一块永久地契空地，并回应了交易所对该交易的询问。同时，集团董事总经理 Yang Kian Lock 在公开市场增持少量股份，但其间接持股因出售 PUSB 全部股权而减少。最新季度业绩公告已发布。
notable: 全资子公司 PFWSI 以 RM6,208,127.50 现金收购 Kuala Langat 一块永久地契空地。
集团董事总经理 Yang Kian Lock 于 2025 年 10 月在公开市场增持 160,200 股。
Yang Kian Lock 出售 Prestij Usaha Sdn. Bhd. 全部股权，728,000 股 PLYTEC 股份。
risks: 交易所就上述土地收购交易向公司发出询问，公司已提供额外资料。
董事总经理间接持股因出售 PUSB 而大幅减少。

Plytec Holding in RM6.2mil land purchase

events.what: 出售 PUSB 全部股权

recent_en: PLYTEC recently agreed to acquire a freehold vacant land in Kuala Langat for RM6.21m and responded to Bursa's query on the deal. Meanwhile, Group MD Yang Kian Lock acquired a small number of shares in the open market, while his indirect interest fell after disposing of his entire stake in PUSB. The latest quarterly results announcement has been released.
notable_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary PFWSI is acquiring a freehold vacant land in Kuala Langat for RM6,208,127.50 cash.
Group MD Yang Kian Lock acquired 160,200 shares in the open market in October 2025.
Yang Kian Lock disposed of his entire stake in Prestij Usaha Sdn. Bhd., ceasing to be deemed interested in the 144,728,000 PLYTEC shares held by it.
risks_en: Bursa Malaysia issued a query on the land acquisition, to which the company has provided additional information.
The Group MD's indirect shareholding dropped substantially following the disposal of PUSB.
